jobs.title: Public Safety Officer
jobs.why: This role builds your Administrative, access, awareness skills and moves you toward becoming a Police Officer.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Public safety officer role likely does not require 21+.
jobs.bridge: As a Public Safety Officer, you're already building critical skills like emergency response, report writing, and verbal communication—all directly transferable to policing. Your hands-on experience with security protocols and Microsoft Word will also prepare you for administrative tasks in law enforcement.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate (Fort Lauderdale International Airport)
jobs.why: This role builds your Administrative, access, awareness skills and moves you toward becoming a Police Officer.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Retail sales associate is suitable for ages 16-20.
jobs.bridge: As a Retail Sales Associate, you'll sharpen communication, organization, and bilingual skills—directly transferable to de-escalation and report-writing as a Police Officer or Security Professional. Plus, inventory management builds the attention to detail and control needed for security operations.

steps: Start with a free Linux course on edX to build foundational OS skills.
Learn C++ basics via Codecademy or a free online tutorial.
Take a secure coding course (e.g., OWASP top 10) to understand vulnerabilities.
Build a small software project (e.g., a security tool) to apply development skills.
Explore AI-assisted workflows by using tools like ChatGPT for code review or automation.
